name: 8a513897c8ed
claim: PEER_CA_SHA256 must be the SHA-256 of the DER-encoded certificate, not the SHA-256 of the PEM file bytes; peer_tls.py hashes the DER bytes extracted from the CERTIFICATE block.

decisions.notes: Using the raw-file SHA-256 fails _verified_ca_der; the DER SHA-256 loads the context and verifies the peer chain.

rationale: The .env.local PEER_CA_SHA256 was correct as a DER SHA-256; the earlier confusion (raw file vs DER) caused a false stale-fingerprint diagnosis.
